Период — UTC-сутки, обе даты включительн: The period is UTC days, both dates inclusive; requests are made within
«Завершённые визиты» — брони со статусом: “Completed visits” are bookings with the “Completed” status whose visit start falls within the period. “Bookings” are counted by creation date, including guest ones.
сумма цен завершённых визитов. Это не вы: the sum of prices of completed visits. This is not revenue: there are no payments in the service, money is counted at the service's price snapshot.
Средний чек — оборот, делённый на заверш: Average check is turnover divided by completed visits. No-shows are no-shows divided by completed plus no-shows; when the denominator is less than 10, absolute numbers are shown. “—” means unknown, not zero.
«Вернувшиеся» — клиенты с завершённым ви: “Returning” are clients with a completed visit before the period; “first visit” are those whose earliest completed visit falls within the period. “New accounts” are accounts created in the period, not new clients: the role in the account is current.
Доля визитов с отзывом — отзывы по завер: Share of visits with a review is reviews for the period's completed visits, as of now: the last days are still incomplete. Median decision time is the 50th percentile of time from submission to decision for requests decided in the period.
Активные барберы — профили, которые акти: Active barbers are profiles that are active and confirmed. Cities are the salon city of the visit; the number of active barbers in a city is as of now.
Зависшие брони — снимок: активные брони: Stuck bookings are a snapshot: active bookings with a start in the past. The snapshot has no previous value.
